$comment: Pseudo-state ledger (RAIL-STYLING-REALIZATION-LEDGERS-01). Two-directional ratchet: the audit fails if any gap is missing here (unledgered) or if any entry no longer reproduces (stale). CAUTION: for several entries the audit's own 'expected selector' is unsatisfiable on the component's root element (':disabled' on a <span>/<div>). Authoring CSS to match the prescribed selector would score realized while changing nothing at runtime. Burning an entry requires runtime proof, not selector presence.

gaps.note: root is <nav>; the hover target is the link descendant, not the root. Needs the state-anchor fact so the IR derives '.breadcrumbs__link:hover' rather than hand-authoring it.

audit prescribes a root-anchored ':disabled', which only matches form controls — this root is <div role=application>, so the selector can NEVER match. Needs the element-aware lowering plus a contract-declared a11y.attribute (aria-disabled); authoring a bare 'disabled' block today would score realized while doing nothing at runtime.

as with 'today': the modifier belongs on the day cell and needs emitter class output.
